# Concrete

**Tags:** `material`

Grey poured stone of ground ashite and soil, cast into blocks at a masonry bench. Heavy and plain; it carries ten floors where dressed stone carries five.

> **Goal:** The first material past stone: a ten-floor building from common ingredients
